title: Pyrana
extract:
The Pyrana is a secondary automatic  Tenno shotgun, available from the Tenno Lab. With its fast fire rate and high  Slash damage, the Pyrana can easily decimate groups of lightly armored targets or the Infested. However, this is counterbalanced by its high recoil and damage falloff.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Advantages over other Secondary  Shotgun Sidearm weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Innate multishot of 12 pellets.
Second highest pellet count of all secondary shotguns, behind  Twin Rogga.
Efficient ammo economy.

Very high multishot (12)
High crit multiplier (2.00x)
Above average active falloff slope (20.6m/%)
Very high average number of crits per shot (2.4)
Above average magazine size (10)
Above average damage per shot (316.8)
Disadvantages over other Secondary  Shotgun Sidearm weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 27.27% from 15m to 30m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Low overall status chance.
Low accuracy.
High recoil, especially on full auto.
Shots goes to the right and up. Horizontally it hits rightmost side of the reticle at 3m, worsening at longer distances.

Acquisition
The Pyrana's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Tips
While more ammo-efficient than other full-auto secondaries like the  Viper,  Pistol Ammo Mutation,  Pistol Scavenger or Squad Ammo Restores can still help counteract the Pyrana's heavy ammo expenditure if fired continuously in full auto.
To reduce the massive amounts of recoil, use  Steady Hands.
 Barrel Diffusion can greatly increase the amount of pellets per shot (a fully ranked Barrel Diffusion can yield up to 26 pellets per shot). Although it can be paired with  Lethal Torrent for more pellets, it will increase your rate of fire tremendously and deplete your ammo very quickly.
However, the net result is 33-34 pellets, the second highest amount of all shotguns, behind the  Twin Rogga. Coupled with its high crit chance, it can be a very deadly close-quarters weapon.
Combining Punch Through mods such as  Seeker will make this weapon especially deadly against clustered enemies coming in too close.

Trivia
The weapon's name, design and description are all derived from the piranha, an omnivorous freshwater fish that inhabits South American rivers. The piranha is well known for hunting its prey in packs and viciously tearing it apart.
